_comment: Single source of truth for Schisler Lab journal figure geometry and type. R reads this via R/journal_fig.R. A Python twin must read THIS file, never restate the numbers, so the two can never drift.
_fonts_comment: Only the collaborator-safe face ships with the package. Licensed families are per-machine, so name them in a project's own journal_fig.json, which jf_config() merges over these defaults. MB Type ships tabular figures as a separate ' Tab' family, which resolve_font() prefers over a registered tnum variant because cairo_pdf cannot see an alias.
_bold_comment: Concourse weights 2,3,4 use weight 6 as their bold (specimen p.7). ggplot face='bold' would synthesize a fake bold instead, so bold elements set the family explicitly. A font with no entry here just uses face='bold'.
_png_comment: 600 not 300. At 7.5 pt a bold axis title is only about 31 px tall at 300 dpi, and bold reads as barely different from regular even though it carries 1.7x the ink. The PNG is a work-in-progress format, never a deliverable, but it should not make you doubt the type.
_colour_comment: journalfig owns STRUCTURE colour only: the axis lines, ticks and the in-panel statistic. Everything that encodes data belongs to the project's own palette and this package must never touch it. Structure is grey so it recedes; content is black.
